title: CURRENT HOURS — Adult swimwear from lane training to the waterfront, 14 deliverables

config.text:
# CURRENT HOURS

## Range
- Product family: adult training swimwear and waterfront cover shirt.
- Wearers: adults who swim regularly and spend time by the water afterwards.
- Style codes: SW01, SW02, SW03, CV01.
- Sizes: S, M, L, XL, 2XL.
- Worn comparison sizes: S and 2XL.
- SW01: training one-piece with a waist seam and centre-front zipper.
- SW02: waist-length pullover swim top.
- SW03: swim shorts with a 100 mm inseam and internal waist drawcord.
- CV01: front-opening cover shirt with a waist seam and two front patch pockets.

## Identity
- Series name: CURRENT HOURS.
- Deep teal: #153C4A.
- Clay: #D97762.
- Chalk: #F2EEE4.
- Internal label line 1: CURRENT HOURS.
- Internal label line 2: Rinse after swimming.
- Internal label line 3: garment size.
- Swim label location: inside back neckline on SW01 and SW02; inside back waistband on SW03.
- Cover shirt label location: inside back neckline on CV01.
- Existing material identity: deep teal compact swim knit, chalk fine lining knit and chalk plain weave, with clay as the pattern accent.

## Coverage and movement
- SW01 and SW02 front coverage: chest from the front underarm-fold level to the waist.
- SW01 and SW03 rear coverage: full seat through the gluteal fold.
- SW01 and SW02 front construction: F01 outer layer over F02 lining.
- SW01 and SW03 seat and crotch construction: F01 outer layer over F02 lining.
- SW01 side measurement: waist seam to leg opening along the side seam.
- SW01 side measurement, S / 2XL: 160 / 230 mm.
- SW01 centre-front zipper length, S / 2XL: 320 / 420 mm.
- CV01 pocket opening length, S / 2XL: 140 / 190 mm.
- CV01 pocket top below waist seam, S / 2XL: 50 / 70 mm.
- Movement states: overhead water entry; arms-overhead streamline.
- Coverage zones in both movement states: chest and full seat.
- Dressing states: opening, putting on, closing.
- Waterfront states: CV01 worn over the swim outfit; CV01 removed and carried.

## Materials and construction
- F01: 78% recycled nylon, 22% elastane; 190 g/m²; usable width 1500 mm; warp knit; chlorine-resistant finish.
- F02: 100% polyester; 110 g/m²; usable width 1500 mm; warp knit; smooth finish.
- F03: 100% polyester; 130 g/m²; usable width 1500 mm; plain weave; washed finish.
- Swim assembly: four-thread overlock seams and 6 mm coverstitched edges.
- Cover shirt assembly: enclosed seams and 6 mm double-turned hems.
- Zippers: 5 mm nylon coil chain, acetal slider.
- SW03 drawcord: 6 mm round polyester cord in an internal waistband channel.

## Settings
- Training: public lap pool with lane ropes, tiled deck and daylight.
- Waterfront: everyday paved waterside walk with seating and afternoon light.

## Body size chart

steps.userMessage:
CURRENT HOURS | Adult swimwear from lane training to the waterfront

We are developing CURRENT HOURS for adults who swim regularly and spend time by the water afterwards. The range has four pieces: SW01, a training one-piece; SW02, a waist-length swim top; SW03, swim shorts with a 100 mm inseam; and CV01, a front-opening cover shirt with two pockets. Develop the silhouettes, seam divisions and pattern together, giving each piece a clear role in the same wardrobe. Sizes are S, M, L, XL and 2XL; the worn work features adults in S and 2XL.

Our material palette is fixed: F01 is 78% recycled nylon and 22% elastane, 190 g/m² warp knit with a chlorine-resistant finish; F02 is 100% polyester, 110 g/m² warp-knit lining; F03 is 100% polyester, 130 g/m² plain weave for the cover shirt. All three have a usable width of 1500 mm. The colours are deep teal #153C4A, clay #D97762 and chalk #F2EEE4. SW01 and SW02 have F01 outer fronts over F02 lining; SW01 and SW03 have lined seats and crotches. Chest and seat coverage continues through an overhead entry pose and a streamline pose. SW02 reaches the waist. The SW01 waist-to-leg-opening side measurement is 160 mm in S and 230 mm in 2XL. Print "CURRENT HOURS" and "Rinse after swimming" on each piece's internal label, with its size beneath.

Audience: the apparel lead, pattern cutter and merchandising team, for the range selection and sampling brief.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed range, coverage and identity facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. 03-range-records.en.md contains the material records, size measurements, construction details and dressing arrangements. coverage-and-movement.png locates the coverage zones, movement poses and measurement landmarks. material-identity.png records the existing textile surfaces and three-colour palette that connect the range. public-pool-reference.png provides the public-pool setting and light. waterfront-reference.png provides the everyday waterfront setting and light.

Deliverables:
1. One materials and craft sheet recording all three fabrics' composition, weight, usable width, construction and finish, the four style codes, sewing methods, hardware and S–2XL garment measurements
2. Two range flat sheets, one front and one back, each containing all four pieces with style codes and readable internal-label insets
3. One material and pattern placement sheet covering the front and back of all four pieces, with fabric codes and pattern boundaries
4. Two movement sheets: SW01 in an overhead water-entry pose, and SW02 with SW03 in a streamline pose, each comparing S and 2XL
5. One dressing sequence sheet with three stages each for SW01 and CV01: opening, putting on and closing
6. One size detail sheet comparing S and 2XL SW01 side coverage and zipper length, plus CV01 pocket opening length and position
7. Three worn styling images using the same two adults: pool training in SW01 and SW02 with SW03; waterfront with CV01 worn over both outfits; and the matching waterfront view with CV01 removed and carried
8. One construction and label detail sheet with the four internal labels, lined front and seat sections, seam finishes, zipper chain and drawcord
9. One 10-second motion video moving from the training outfits to the covered waterfront outfits, with the series name and four style codes
10. One range presentation of at least 10 pages, reusing the craft sheet, flats, placement sheet, movement studies and styling images, with the series name, fabric codes and S/2XL dimensions

Acceptance:
- The materials and craft sheet records F01, F02 and F03, all four style codes and all five sizes; the placement sheet and presentation repeat those fabric codes, and the size detail sheet and presentation repeat its S/2XL dimensions.
- The front flats, back flats and placement sheet each contain SW01, SW02, SW03 and CV01; their seam divisions and pattern boundaries correspond, with F02 beneath the SW01/SW02 fronts and the SW01/SW03 seats and crotches.
- The size detail sheet labels SW01 side coverage as 160/230 mm and zipper length as 320/420 mm for S/2XL; it labels CV01 pocket openings as 140/190 mm and their top edges as 50/70 mm below the waist seam. The movement sheets carry these size-specific seam and opening positions into both poses.
- The dressing sheet contains six stages across SW01 and CV01; the three styling images retain the same two adults, swim pieces and pattern placements, with two CV01 pockets visible in the covered view and the removed shirts carried in the uncovered view.
- The flats' label insets and construction sheet show "CURRENT HOURS", "Rinse after swimming" and the relevant size on all four labels; the construction sheet also identifies the 5 mm zipper chain and 6 mm drawcord.
- The 10-second video names CURRENT HOURS and SW01, SW02, SW03 and CV01; the presentation contains at least 10 pages and repeats #153C4A, #D97762 and #F2EEE4 alongside the earlier range images.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
